prs.title: fix(cart): cap a coupon at 100 percent
prs.body:
## Why
A coupon over 100 percent pays the customer.
prs.head: pf/mwdirr4d/babysit-drive/feat-coupon-cap

comments.author: just-joshn
comments.body:
babysit: PR 14 conflicts with trunk in src/cart.js. The owner of branch feat-coupon-cap needs to rebase it onto trunk and publish with --force-with-lease.
Drift sweep: trunk changed applyCoupon, so check its callers in src/checkout.js in the same wave.

comments.author: just-joshn
comments.body:
Severity: Low
Duplicated clamp logic: `Math.min(percent, 100)` already exists in `src/checkout.js`, so extract a shared helper.
RUN_ID: bb-1

comments.author: just-joshn
comments.body: Dismissed: git grep for Math.min under src/ finds one clamp, in src/cart.js. src/checkout.js has none and calls total(), so there is no duplicate to extract.
